# Level 8 · Ship It

Demos impress; systems survive. This level is the unglamorous code that decides whether an AI feature can be trusted next week: an eval harness that catches regressions hiding behind a better average, a cache that stops you paying twice for the same answer, and a parser that pulls valid JSON out of whatever the model actually said.
